class.name: Edge
class.brief_description: A minimal topological edge wrapper used by the current build123d port.
class.description: [Edge] currently exposes only the functionality required by [Axis]. Use [method make_line] to create a straight edge between two points.

method.name: make_line
method.description: Creates a straight edge from [param start] to [param end].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this wrapper contains a valid OpenCASCADE edge.
